sampling.method: deterministic display sample by sensor and UTC month
sampling.note: Daily counts describe every source row in each rectangular AOI; map points are a deterministic performance sample.

provenance.mirror: Portolan FIRMS catalog on Source Cooperative
provenance.sourceQuality: Preserves source-provided SP/NRT labels; NRT is provisional.
provenance.caveat: A row is a detected thermal-anomaly pixel, not a unique fire or burned area. Positive-only records cannot establish coverage or confirmed no-fire conditions. MODIS and VIIRS counts are not directly comparable.
